 Match Preview
 UEFA Nations League B - Game Week 6 Nov 17, 2026 - 13:45 Kosice Football Arena Ukraine host Georgia at the Kosice Football Arena in Kosice in UEFA Nations League B Group 2, with both sides arriving at this fixture in contrasting states of form.
 Andrea Maldera's Ukraine have endured a difficult campaign. They have lost three of their last five matches, including back-to-back defeats to Northern Ireland and Hungary in October, and sit third in the group standings heading into this fixture.
 Georgia's Nations League run has been no less turbulent. Ramaz Svanadze's side are bottom of Group 2 after five matches, with four defeats from their last five outings. A 2-0 loss to Hungary on November 14 leaves their position precarious.
 The two sides drew 0-0 when they met earlier in this campaign, in September in Tbilisi. That result now feels like a distant memory for Georgia, who have not picked up a point since.
 For Ukraine, a win here would ease some of the pressure that has built through a run of poor results. For Georgia, the task is simpler to define and harder to achieve: win, or face almost certain relegation.
 Read on for everything you need to know about how to watch Ukraine vs Georgia live, including kick-off time, TV channel, and live stream options.
